note: Deadlines move and aggregators lag. Confirm against the official page before writing anything. Not published: this directory is outside docs/ and never reaches the site.

leads.name: Wien Kultur — Einzelförderung darstellende Kunst
leads.note: Covers projects in H2 2027 and annual funding 2028. Apply BEFORE the federal one: BMWKMS funds subsidiär to regional bodies, so the city commitment strengthens it.

leads.name: BMWKMS — Projektförderung darstellende Kunst
leads.amount: partial financing, subsidiary to regional funding
leads.note: Individuals with Austrian citizenship OR permanent residence. No age or degree-recency gate. Needs >=3 performances, predominantly in Austria. Check the 'sich in Ausbildung befindende Personen' exclusion if you enrol: mdk@bmkoes.gv.at

leads.name: FWF PEEK — Programme for Arts-based Research
leads.note: Best long-term fit: artistic practice central to the research question. No degree or citizenship requirement for the PI. REQUIRES an Austrian research institution. Board decides in May and Nov/Dec.

leads.name: FWF ASTRA Awards
leads.amount: EUR 500k-1M over 5 years; +EUR 200k tenure package for women
leads.note: Arts-based researchers WITHOUT doctorates may apply with 2-9 years relevant experience. Half of awards go to women. But targets R3 'internationally visible researchers' and needs an Austrian host. Replaced Elise Richter PEEK.

leads.name: Culture Moves Europe — Individual Mobility
leads.note: 2025-26 call closed 30 Apr 2026; next opens autumn 2026. Fits a residency inside the twelve-week studio process.

leads.name: MSCA Doctoral Networks 2026
leads.note: Institutions apply, not individuals. Your route is applying to a funded position inside a network, not writing a proposal.

leads.name: Angewandte — Artistic Research PhD (PhD in Art)
leads.note: 2026 window was 9-20 Feb and has passed. Enrolment unlocks PEEK, DOC and ASTRA, all of which need an Austrian institution.

leads.name: Academy of Fine Arts — PhD-in-Practice
leads.note: Four-year practice-based doctorate, transdisciplinary and international. Second Vienna route alongside the Angewandte.

leads.name: BMWKMS — Projektförderung (second window)
leads.note: Same programme, for work starting from the following July.

leads.name: circusnext — European Circus Label
leads.amount: EUR 3,000 finalists / EUR 5,000 laureates + labs, network
leads.note: Money is small; the label and European platform are the point. Emerging circus authors resident in Creative Europe countries.

leads.name: ÖAW DOC Fellowship
leads.note: Requires the Master's completed no more than TWO years ago, and enrolment not yet begun or in its first year. Only worth checking if your Master's is recent.

leads.name: START-Stipendien Musik und darstellende Kunst
leads.note: Requires a degree no more than five years old, or for artists without university training, born after 31 Dec 1990.

leads.name: SKE Fonds (austro mechana)
leads.note: Funds composers holding a royalty agreement. Only relevant if a composer collaborator applies for a score.

leads.name: Elise Richter PEEK
leads.note: DISCONTINUED, folded into ASTRA. Several aggregators still list it. Do not spend a cycle on it.

leads.name: НФК — Създаване и разпространение, малки проекти
leads.note: OPEN NOW (from 06.08.2026). Bulgarian citizenship qualifies you even though you live in Austria. CONFIRM whether физически лица may apply to this programme -- Мобилност says individuals explicitly, this one is unverified.

leads.name: НФК — Създаване и разпространение, големи проекти
leads.note: Opens 15.09.2026. Same eligibility question as the small-projects call.

leads.name: НФК — Мобилност, сесия 2
leads.note: Opens 01.10.2026. Explicitly open to individual artists with Bulgarian citizenship OR right of residence in Bulgaria -- citizenship qualifies you from Vienna. Funds participation in international forums at home and abroad.

leads.name: НФК — Цирк
leads.note: Artform-matched but ORGANISATIONS ONLY: Bulgarian private cultural organisations and читалища. Needs a Bulgarian organisational partner. 2026 sessions ran June-July and have closed.

leads.name: НФК — Целева подкрепа „Творческа Европа“
leads.note: Co-finances projects already approved under Creative Europe. Legal entities only, so relevant only through a partner organisation.
